queue.hypothesis: Adding orthogonal state rotation before GDN update will improve memory precision by decorrelating state dimensions within the state_size=32 constraint.
queue.rationale: State dimension correlation may waste capacity; orthogonal rotation can spread information more evenly across state dimensions without violating the hard state_size limit.
queue.instruction: Add a learnable orthogonal matrix (32x32) as a linear transformation applied to the state before the GDN update and its inverse after. Use a skew-symmetric initialization and enforce orthogonality via expm or QR decomposition during forward pass.
